label: Sales
title: Sales
description: Just new to MAQSU? Get off to a flying start, learn how to create an company, customers, vendors, chart of accounts, add security to your account.

items.title: Introduction
items.description: In MAQSU ERP Software, the **Sales Module** is a core business application designed to manage the entire sales process — from creating quotations to confirming sales orders, delivering products, and issuing invoices. It helps businesses streamline their sales operations, track customer interactions, and improve efficiency across departments.

items.title: Confirm Sales Orders
items.description: In this section, you will learn how to create **quotations** and **sales orders** — two essential steps in the sales process. By the end of this section, you will understand how to efficiently manage quotations and sales orders to streamline your company’s sales workflow.

items.title: Settings
items.description: The **Sales Settings** section in MAQSU ERP allows users to configure how the Sales Module behaves according to the company’s policies and workflow. It provides options to customize quotation management, pricing, invoicing, and integration with other modules like inventory and accounting. Proper configuration of sales settings ensures that your sales operations run smoothly, accurately, and in line with business requirements.
